translations.web: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
translations.bsb: North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
translations.kjv: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
translations.asv: The north and the south, thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon rejoice in thy name.
